newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industry expects no pick-up in demand.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industry expects no pick-up in demand.

text.p: Over half of Argentine industrialists believe domestic demand will not pick up this month compared to a third who believe it will, showed a poll released Monday by the National Statistics Institute.
The survey shows 56.9 percent expect unchanged demand, 34.5 percent are optimistic and 8.6 percent see less demand.
Asked about demand from abroad, 26.4 percent of companies expect it to improve while 58.5 percent see no change and 15.1 percent expect a drop in overseas demand.
On staffing levels, 81.3 percent consider present numbers adequate and only 3.4 percent say they are insufficient, while 15.3 percent believe they are excessively staffed.
The survey was released with official monthly statistics on industrial output and no details of margin of error or the size of the survey were available.
